ACCELEROCK.name: Accelerock
ACCELEROCK.effect: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

ACID_ARMOR.name: Acid Armor
ACID_ARMOR.effect: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

ALLURING_VOICE.name: Alluring Voice
ALLURING_VOICE.effect: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

AMNESIA.name: Amnesia
AMNESIA.effect: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user’s Sp. Def stat.

ANCHOR_SHOT.name: Anchor Shot
ANCHOR_SHOT.effect: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee or switched out of battle.

APPLE_ACID.name: Apple Acid
APPLE_ACID.effect: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

AQUA_CUTTER.name: Aqua Cutter
AQUA_CUTTER.effect: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

AQUA_STEP.name: Aqua Step
AQUA_STEP.effect: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

ARMOR_CANNON.name: Armor Cannon
ARMOR_CANNON.effect: The user attacks by shooting off its own armor as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

ARM_THRUST.name: Arm Thrust
ARM_THRUST.effect: The user attacks the target with open-palmed arm thrusts. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

AROMATHERAPY.name: Aromatherapy
AROMATHERAPY.effect: The user releases a soothing scent to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

AROMATIC_MIST.name: Aromatic Mist
AROMATIC_MIST.effect: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

ASSURANCE.name: Assurance
ASSURANCE.effect: This move’s power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.

ASTRAL_BARRAGE.name: Astral Barrage
ASTRAL_BARRAGE.effect: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

ATTACK_ORDER.name: Attack Order
ATTACK_ORDER.effect: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

AURORA_VEIL.name: Aurora Veil
AURORA_VEIL.effect: This move halves the damage taken from physical and special moves for 5 turns. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead. This can be used only under hail or when it is snowing.

AUTOTOMIZE.name: Autotomize
AUTOTOMIZE.effect: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter. This sharply boosts the user’s Speed stat.

BABY_DOLL_EYES.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
BABY_DOLL_EYES.effect: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target’s Attack stat. This move always goes first.

BADDY_BAD.name: Baddy Bad
BADDY_BAD.effect: The user acts bad and attacks the target. A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from physical moves. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

BANEFUL_BUNKER.name: Baneful Bunker
BANEFUL_BUNKER.effect: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn become poisoned. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

BARB_BARRAGE.name: Barb Barrage
BARB_BARRAGE.effect: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This move has a 50% chance of poisoning the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

BELLY_DRUM.name: Belly Drum
BELLY_DRUM.effect: The user loses ½ of its max HP to maximize its Attack stat. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

BITTER_BLADE.name: Bitter Blade
BITTER_BLADE.effect: The user attacks by focusing all its bitter feelings toward this world into a slashing attack. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

BITTER_MALICE.name: Bitter Malice
BITTER_MALICE.effect: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

BLUE_FLARE.name: Blue Flare
BLUE_FLARE.effect: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This move has a 20% chance of burning the target.

BODY_PRESS.name: Body Press
BODY_PRESS.effect: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The damage dealt by this move is determined using the user’s Defense stat instead of its Attack stat.

BOLT_STRIKE.name: Bolt Strike
BOLT_STRIKE.effect: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges the target. This move has a 20% chance of paralyzing the target.

BONE_RUSH.name: Bone Rush
BONE_RUSH.effect: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

BOUNCE.name: Bounce
BOUNCE.effect: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

BOUNCY_BUBBLE.name: Bouncy Bubble
BOUNCY_BUBBLE.effect: The user attacks by shooting water bubbles at the target. It then absorbs water and restores its HP by 100% of the damage dealt by this move.

BRANCH_POKE.name: Branch Poke
BRANCH_POKE.effect: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

BULK_UP.name: Bulk Up
BULK_UP.effect: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

BURNING_BULWARK.name: Burning Bulwark
BURNING_BULWARK.effect: The user intensely heats up a part of its body, protecting it from attacks and also causing burns to any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

BURNING_JEALOUSY.name: Burning Jealousy
BURNING_JEALOUSY.effect: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

BUZZY_BUZZ.name: Buzzy Buzz
BUZZY_BUZZ.effect: The user shoots a jolt of electricity to attack the target. This also paralyzes the target.

CALM_MIND.name: Calm Mind
CALM_MIND.effect: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

CAPTIVATE.name: Captivate
CAPTIVATE.effect: If any opposing Pokémon is the opposite gender of the user, it is charmed, which harshly lowers its Sp. Atk stat.

CEASELESS_EDGE.name: Ceaseless Edge
CEASELESS_EDGE.effect: The user slashes a sharpened blade at the target, leaving splinters under the target as spikes. Pokémon that switch into battle take damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP. Up to three layers can be set, with each layer increasing the damage taken. Flying types or Pokémon with Levitate are unaffected by these spikes.

CHARGE.name: Charge
CHARGE.effect: The user becomes charged, doubling the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Def stat.

CHILLING_WATER.name: Chilling Water
CHILLING_WATER.effect: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that’s so cold it saps the target’s power. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

CHIP_AWAY.name: Chip Away
CHIP_AWAY.effect: Looking for an opening, the user strikes consistently. This move ignores the target’s stat changes when dealing damage.

CLANGING_SCALES.name: Clanging Scales
CLANGING_SCALES.effect: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user’s Defense stat is lowered after the attack.

CLANGOROUS_SOUL.name: Clangorous Soul
CLANGOROUS_SOUL.effect: The user loses ⅓ of its max HP to boost its Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

CLEAR_SMOG.name: Clear Smog
CLEAR_SMOG.effect: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.

COACHING.name: Coaching
COACHING.effect: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

COIL.name: Coil
COIL.effect: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

COLLISION_COURSE.name: Collision Course
COLLISION_COURSE.effect: The user rushes forward and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.

CONFIDE.name: Confide
CONFIDE.effect: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

CONSTRICT.name: Constrict
CONSTRICT.effect: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles, vines, or the like. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Speed stat.

CORE_ENFORCER.name: Core Enforcer
CORE_ENFORCER.effect: The user attacks by firing off a powerful beam that scorches across the battlefield. If the Pokémon damaged by this move have already used their moves that turn, this move eliminates the effects of those Pokémon’s Abilities.

COSMIC_POWER.name: Cosmic Power
COSMIC_POWER.effect: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

COTTON_GUARD.name: Cotton Guard
COTTON_GUARD.effect: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.

COTTON_SPORE.name: Cotton Spore
COTTON_SPORE.effect: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.

COVET.name: Covet
COVET.effect: The user endearingly approaches the target, then tries to steal from the target. This move has a 30% chance to steal one of the target’s held items.

DEFOG.name: Defog
DEFOG.effect: A strong wind blows away the target’s barriers such as Light Screen, Reflect, Aurora Veil, or Safeguard, as well as any entry hazards or terrain from the field. This also lowers the target’s evasiveness, and can clear deep fog.

DETECT.name: Detect
DETECT.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

DIAMOND_STORM.name: Diamond Storm
DIAMOND_STORM.effect: The user attacks by engulfing targets in a storm of diamonds. This move has a 50% chance to sharply boost the user’s Defense stat.

DIRE_CLAW.name: Dire Claw
DIRE_CLAW.effect: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This move has a 30% chance of leaving the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

DIVE.name: Dive
DIVE.effect: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.

DOUBLE_HIT.name: Double Hit
DOUBLE_HIT.effect: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.

DOUBLE_SHOCK.name: Double Shock
DOUBLE_SHOCK.effect: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack, and loses the Electric type. This move fails unless it is used by a Electric type.

DRAGON_DANCE.name: Dragon Dance
DRAGON_DANCE.effect: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

DRAGON_DARTS.name: Dragon Darts
DRAGON_DARTS.effect: The user attacks twice by launching draconic arrows. If there are 2 opposing Pokémon, each of them is attacked once.

DRAGON_HAMMER.name: Dragon Hammer
DRAGON_HAMMER.effect: The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

DRAGON_RUSH.name: Dragon Rush
DRAGON_RUSH.effect: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

DUAL_WINGBEAT.name: Dual Wingbeat
DUAL_WINGBEAT.effect: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

ECHOED_VOICE.name: Echoed Voice
ECHOED_VOICE.effect: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. This move’s power is increased by 40 each turn this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, up to a max of 200.

EERIE_IMPULSE.name: Eerie Impulse
EERIE_IMPULSE.effect: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

ELECTROWEB.name: Electroweb
ELECTROWEB.effect: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

ELECTRO_BALL.name: Electro Ball
ELECTRO_BALL.effect: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The higher the user’s Speed stat compared to the target’s, the greater this move’s power (ranging between 40 and 150).

ELECTRO_DRIFT.name: Electro Drift
ELECTRO_DRIFT.effect: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.

ERUPTION.name: Eruption
ERUPTION.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The less HP the user has left, the lower this move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).

ESPER_WING.name: Esper Wing
ESPER_WING.effect: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings, boosting its Speed stat. This move’s critical-hit ratio is also boosted by 1 stage.

EXPANDING_FORCE.name: Expanding Force
EXPANDING_FORCE.effect: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. If the user is under the effect of Psychic Terrain, this move’s power is boosted by 50% and its range extends to all opponents.

EXPLOSION.name: Explosion
EXPLOSION.effect: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

EXTREME_SPEED.name: Extreme Speed
EXTREME_SPEED.effect: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

FACADE.name: Facade
FACADE.effect: This move’s power is doubled if the user is poisoned, badly poisoned, burned, or paralyzed. Although this move is a physical move, the damage it deals is not halved when the user is burned.

FAKE_OUT.name: Fake Out
FAKE_OUT.effect: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

FAKE_TEARS.name: Fake Tears
FAKE_TEARS.effect: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

FALSE_SURRENDER.name: False Surrender
FALSE_SURRENDER.effect: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

FEINT.name: Feint
FEINT.effect: This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.

FICKLE_BEAM.name: Fickle Beam
FICKLE_BEAM.effect: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. There is a 30% chance that all of the user’s heads will shoot beams in unison, doubling the move’s power.

FIERY_DANCE.name: Fiery Dance
FIERY_DANCE.effect: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and attacks the target. This move has a 50% chance of boosting the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

FIERY_WRATH.name: Fiery Wrath
FIERY_WRATH.effect: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This move has a 20% chance of making targets flinch.

FILLET_AWAY.name: Fillet Away
FILLET_AWAY.effect: The user loses ½ of its max HP to sharply boost its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

FIRE_LASH.name: Fire Lash
FIRE_LASH.effect: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.

FIRE_PLEDGE.name: Fire Pledge
FIRE_PLEDGE.effect: A column of fire hits the target. When used alongside Water Pledge or Grass Pledge, the moves will combine for 150 base power and summon a rainbow or vast sea of fire, respectively, for 4 turns.

FIRST_IMPRESSION.name: First Impression
FIRST_IMPRESSION.effect: The user attacks with tremendous power, but this move only succeeds if it is used first thing upon the user entering a battle.

FLAIL.name: Flail
FLAIL.effect: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 20 and 200).

FLARE_BLITZ.name: Flare Blitz
FLARE_BLITZ.effect: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move. This also has a 10% chance of burning the target and thaws out the user if it is frozen.

FLASH.name: Flash
FLASH.effect: The user flashes a bright light that lowers the target’s accuracy.

FLATTER.name: Flatter
FLATTER.effect: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

FLIP_TURN.name: Flip Turn
FLIP_TURN.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

FLOATY_FALL.name: Floaty Fall
FLOATY_FALL.effect: The user floats in the air, and then dives at a steep angle to attack the target. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

FLOWER_SHIELD.name: Flower Shield
FLOWER_SHIELD.effect: The user boosts the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.

FREEZE_DRY.name: Freeze-Dry
FREEZE_DRY.effect: The user attacks by rapidly lowering target’s temperature. This move is also super effective against Water type Pokémon.

FREEZY_FROST.name: Freezy Frost
FREEZY_FROST.effect: The user attacks with a crystal made of cold frozen haze. It eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

FURY_ATTACK.name: Fury Attack
FURY_ATTACK.effect: The user attacks by jabbing the target with a horn, a beak, or the like. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

FURY_SWIPES.name: Fury Swipes
FURY_SWIPES.effect: The user attacks by raking the target with claws, scythes, or the like. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

GLAIVE_RUSH.name: Glaive Rush
GLAIVE_RUSH.effect: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

GLARE.name: Glare
GLARE.effect: The user intimidates the target with a frightful glare that will leave it paralyzed.

GLITZY_GLOW.name: Glitzy Glow
GLITZY_GLOW.effect: The user bombards the target with telekinetic force. A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from special moves. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

GRASSY_GLIDE.name: Grassy Glide
GRASSY_GLIDE.effect: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. If the user is under the effect of Grassy Terrain, this move always goes first.

GRASS_PLEDGE.name: Grass Pledge
GRASS_PLEDGE.effect: A column of grass hits the target. When used alongside Water Pledge or Fire Pledge, the moves will combine for 150 base power and summon a vast swamp or sea of fire, respectively, for 4 turns.

GRASS_WHISTLE.name: Grass Whistle
GRASS_WHISTLE.effect: The user plays a pleasant melody that puts the target to sleep.

GRAV_APPLE.name: Grav Apple
GRAV_APPLE.effect: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat. This move’s power is boosted by 50% when Gravity is active.

HAIL.name: Hail
HAIL.effect: The user summons a hailstorm lasting 5 turns. All Pokémon except Ice types will be damaged for ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP at the end of every turn.

HAMMER_ARM.name: Hammer Arm
HAMMER_ARM.effect: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user’s Speed stat.

HARD_PRESS.name: Hard Press
HARD_PRESS.effect: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 100).

HEADLONG_RUSH.name: Headlong Rush
HEADLONG_RUSH.effect: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

HEAD_CHARGE.name: Head Charge
HEAD_CHARGE.effect: The user charges its head into the target, using its powerful guard hair. The user takes ¼ of the damage dealt by this move.

HEAD_SMASH.name: Head Smash
HEAD_SMASH.effect: The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. The user takes ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

HEAL_BELL.name: Heal Bell
HEAL_BELL.effect: The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

HEAL_PULSE.name: Heal Pulse
HEAL_PULSE.effect: The user emits a healing pulse that restores ½ of the target’s max HP.

HEAT_CRASH.name: Heat Crash
HEAT_CRASH.effect: The user slams into the target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 40 and 120). If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

HONE_CLAWS.name: Hone Claws
HONE_CLAWS.effect: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

HORN_LEECH.name: Horn Leech
HORN_LEECH.effect: The user drains the target’s energy with its horns. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

HOWL.name: Howl
HOWL.effect: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

HYDRO_STEAM.name: Hydro Steam
HYDRO_STEAM.effect: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move’s power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50%.

HYPER_VOICE.name: Hyper Voice
HYPER_VOICE.effect: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

ICE_BALL.name: Ice Ball
ICE_BALL.effect: The user continually rolls into the target over 5 turns. This attack doubles in power each time it hits, and resets after 5 turns have passed or if the move is interrupted.

ICE_HAMMER.name: Ice Hammer
ICE_HAMMER.effect: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user’s Speed stat.

ICE_SPINNER.name: Ice Spinner
ICE_SPINNER.effect: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move’s spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

ICICLE_CRASH.name: Icicle Crash
ICICLE_CRASH.effect: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

INFERNO.name: Inferno
INFERNO.effect: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

IRON_DEFENSE.name: Iron Defense
IRON_DEFENSE.effect: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

IVY_CUDGEL.name: Ivy Cudgel
IVY_CUDGEL.effect: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel, this move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage. When used by Ogerpon, this move’s type changes depending on the mask worn.

JAW_LOCK.name: Jaw Lock
JAW_LOCK.effect: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

JUDGMENT.name: Judgment
JUDGMENT.effect: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move’s type changes depending on the kind of Plate or Memory Disc the user is holding, if it has the Multitype or RKS System ability.

KINESIS.name: Kinesis
KINESIS.effect: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

KINGS_SHIELD.name: King’s Shield
KINGS_SHIELD.effect: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn will have their Attack stats lowered. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

KNOCK_OFF.name: Knock Off
KNOCK_OFF.effect: The user slaps down a target’s held item, removing the item. This move’s power is boosted by 50% if the target has a held item.

KOWTOW_CLEAVE.name: Kowtow Cleave
KOWTOW_CLEAVE.effect: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

LANDS_WRATH.name: Land’s Wrath
LANDS_WRATH.effect: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to inflict damage.

LASH_OUT.name: Lash Out
LASH_OUT.effect: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user’s stats were lowered during this turn.

LAST_RESPECTS.name: Last Respects
LAST_RESPECTS.effect: The user attacks to avenge its allies. This move’s power is increased by 50 for each time that a Pokémon in the user’s party has fainted.

LAVA_PLUME.name: Lava Plume
LAVA_PLUME.effect: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This move has a 30% chance of burning targets.

LIFE_DEW.name: Life Dew
LIFE_DEW.effect: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores ¼ of the user and its ally Pokémon’s max HP.

LIGHT_OF_RUIN.name: Light of Ruin
LIGHT_OF_RUIN.effect: Drawing in mystical energy, the user fires a powerful beam of light. The user takes ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

LOVELY_KISS.name: Lovely Kiss
LOVELY_KISS.effect: With a scary face, the user tries to kiss the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

LUMINA_CRASH.name: Lumina Crash
LUMINA_CRASH.effect: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

MAGICAL_TORQUE.name: Magical Torque
MAGICAL_TORQUE.effect: The user rams into the target with a fae-like force. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target.

MAGNETIC_FLUX.name: Magnetic Flux
MAGNETIC_FLUX.effect: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus Ability or the Minus Ability.

MAGNITUDE.name: Magnitude
MAGNITUDE.effect: The user attacks everything around it with a ground-shaking quake. Its power varies based on the magnitude of the quake, with the possibility of being 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 110, or 150 power. This move’s power is doubled against targets underground from Dig, and halved while Grassy Terrain is active.

MAKE_IT_RAIN.name: Make It Rain
MAKE_IT_RAIN.effect: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat. If a target is successfully struck, you will earn money after the battle.

MALIGNANT_CHAIN.name: Malignant Chain
MALIGNANT_CHAIN.effect: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This move has a 50% chance of badly poisoning the target.

MATCHA_GOTCHA.name: Matcha Gotcha
MATCHA_GOTCHA.effect: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move, and has a 20% chance of burning targets. This will also thaw out a frozen user or target.

MEMENTO.name: Memento
MEMENTO.effect: The user faints. In return, the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.

METEOR_ASSAULT.name: Meteor Assault
METEOR_ASSAULT.effect: The user attacks wildly with a long weapon. However, this also makes the user stagger, leaving it unable to move next turn.

MIGHTY_CLEAVE.name: Mighty Cleave
MIGHTY_CLEAVE.effect: The user wields the light that has accumulated through its blades to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

MILK_DRINK.name: Milk Drink
MILK_DRINK.effect: The user drinks highly nutritious milk, restoring ½ of its max HP.

MISTY_EXPLOSION.name: Misty Explosion
MISTY_EXPLOSION.effect: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. If the user is under the effect of Misty Terrain, this move’s power is boosted by 50%.

MOONLIGHT.name: Moonlight
MOONLIGHT.effect: The user bathes in the soothing light of the moon, restoring ½ of its max HP. In harsh sunlight, ⅔ of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions, ¼ of its max HP will be restored instead.

MORNING_SUN.name: Morning Sun
MORNING_SUN.effect: The user bathes in the pleasant rays of the sun, restoring ½ of its max HP. In harsh sunlight, ⅔ of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions, ¼ of its max HP will be restored instead.

MORTAL_SPIN.name: Mortal Spin
MORTAL_SPIN.effect: The user performs a spin attack that can eliminate the effects of binding moves and Leech Seed, as well as any entry hazards on its side. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

MOUNTAIN_GALE.name: Mountain Gale
MOUNTAIN_GALE.effect: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

NASTY_PLOT.name: Nasty Plot
NASTY_PLOT.effect: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

NEEDLE_ARM.name: Needle Arm
NEEDLE_ARM.effect: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

NIGHT_DAZE.name: Night Daze
NIGHT_DAZE.effect: The user looses a pitch-black shock wave at the target to inflict damage. This move has a 40% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

NOBLE_ROAR.name: Noble Roar
NOBLE_ROAR.effect: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

NOXIOUS_TORQUE.name: Noxious Torque
NOXIOUS_TORQUE.effect: The user rams into the target with a poisonous end. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

NO_RETREAT.name: No Retreat
NO_RETREAT.effect: The user puts everything on the line and boosts its Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats. In exchange, the user loses the ability to flee or be switched out of battle. Can only be used once per time the user enters battle.

NUZZLE.name: Nuzzle
NUZZLE.effect: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This paralyzes the target.

ORDER_UP.name: Order Up
ORDER_UP.effect: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts the user’s stats based on the Tatsugiri’s form: Attack for Curly Tatsugiri, Defense for Droopy, or Speed for Stretchy.

OVERDRIVE.name: Overdrive
OVERDRIVE.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with an electrifying soundwave, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

PHANTOM_FORCE.name: Phantom Force
PHANTOM_FORCE.effect: The user attacks by disappearing into the shadows for a short time, then surfacing to strike the target on the next turn. This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.

PHOTON_GEYSER.name: Photon Geyser
PHOTON_GEYSER.effect: The user attacks the target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability (with certain exceptions).

PLAY_NICE.name: Play Nice
PLAY_NICE.effect: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.

PLUCK.name: Pluck
PLUCK.effect: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

POISON_GAS.name: Poison Gas
POISON_GAS.effect: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the faces of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.

POISON_TAIL.name: Poison Tail
POISON_TAIL.effect: The user hits the target with its tail. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage and has a 10% chance of poisoning the target.

POLLEN_PUFF.name: Pollen Puff
POLLEN_PUFF.effect: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. When used on an ally, this move restores ½ of its max HP instead of dealing damage.

POUNCE.name: Pounce
POUNCE.effect: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

POWER_TRIP.name: Power Trip
POWER_TRIP.effect: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. This move’s power is increased by 20 for each stage that the user’s stats have been boosted.

PROTECT.name: Protect
PROTECT.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

PSYBLADE.name: Psyblade
PSYBLADE.effect: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move’s power is boosted by 50% if the user is on Electric Terrain.

PSYCHIC_NOISE.name: Psychic Noise
PSYCHIC_NOISE.effect: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For 2 turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

PUNISHMENT.name: Punishment
PUNISHMENT.effect: This move’s power is increased by 20 for each stage that the target’s stats have been boosted.

PURSUIT.name: Pursuit
PURSUIT.effect: The power of this attack move is doubled if it’s used on a target that’s switching out of battle.

QUIVER_DANCE.name: Quiver Dance
QUIVER_DANCE.effect: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

RAGING_FURY.name: Raging Fury
RAGING_FURY.effect: The user rampages around spewing flames for 2-3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

RAIN_DANCE.name: Rain Dance
RAIN_DANCE.effect: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for 5 turns, powering up Water-type moves by 50%. The rain also halves the damage dealt by Fire-type moves.

RAPID_SPIN.name: Rapid Spin
RAPID_SPIN.effect: The user performs a spin attack that can eliminate the effects of binding moves and Leech Seed, as well as any entry hazards on its side. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

RELIC_SONG.name: Relic Song
RELIC_SONG.effect: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of the listening opposing Pokémon. This move has a 10% chance of putting the target to sleep. If used by Meloetta, it will cause it to swap between its Aria and Pirouette Formes.

RETALIATE.name: Retaliate
RETALIATE.effect: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move’s power is doubled if an ally fainted in the previous turn.

REVENGE.name: Revenge
REVENGE.effect: The user moves last. The power of this move is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

REVERSAL.name: Reversal
REVERSAL.effect: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has (ranging between 20 and 200).

RISING_VOLTAGE.name: Rising Voltage
RISING_VOLTAGE.effect: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move’s power is doubled if the target is under the effect of Electric Terrain.

ROCK_CLIMB.name: Rock Climb
ROCK_CLIMB.effect: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. This move has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

ROCK_POLISH.name: Rock Polish
ROCK_POLISH.effect: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user’s Speed stat.

ROOST.name: Roost
ROOST.effect: The user lands and rests its body, restoring ½ of its max HP. If the user is a Flying type, it will lose the Flying type for the turn.

ROTOTILLER.name: Rototiller
ROTOTILLER.effect: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. This boosts the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of all grounded Grass-type Pokémon in battle.

ROUND.name: Round
ROUND.effect: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be doubled.

RUINATION.name: Ruination
RUINATION.effect: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This deals damage to the target equal to ½ of their remaining HP.

SALT_CURE.name: Salt Cure
SALT_CURE.effect: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage equal to ¹⁄₁₆ of the target’s max HP at the end of every turn. Steel and Water types take damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP instead.

SANDSTORM.name: Sandstorm
SANDSTORM.effect: The user summons a sandstorm for 5 turns, Pokémon that are not Rock, Ground, or Steel types take damage equal to ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP at the end of every turn. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types by 50%.

SAPPY_SEED.name: Sappy Seed
SAPPY_SEED.effect: The user grows a gigantic stalk that scatters seeds to attack the target. At the end of every turn, ⅛ of the target’s max HP gets absorbed by the user or any Pokémon that takes its place in battle.

SCALE_SHOT.name: Scale Shot
SCALE_SHOT.effect: The user attacks by shooting scales 2-5 times in a row. This move boosts the user’s Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

SCARY_FACE.name: Scary Face
SCARY_FACE.effect: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

SECRET_POWER.name: Secret Power
SECRET_POWER.effect: The additional effects of this attack depend upon the biome or terrain it was used in.

SECRET_SWORD.name: Secret Sword
SECRET_SWORD.effect: The user attacks by slashing targets with a long sword. The odd power contained in the sword does physical damage to the target. If a Keldeo knows this move, it will transform into its Resolute form.

SHARPEN.name: Sharpen
SHARPEN.effect: The user makes its edges more jagged, which boosts its Attack stat.

SHEER_COLD.name: Sheer Cold
SHEER_COLD.effect: The target is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The target faints instantly if this attack hits, unless it is a Boss Pokémon. This move does not affect Ice types. The accuracy of this move is fixed at 30%. If used by Pokémon other than Ice types, the accuracy of this move is 20%.

SHELL_SIDE_ARM.name: Shell Side Arm
SHELL_SIDE_ARM.effect: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This move has a 20% chance of poisoning the target.

SHELL_SMASH.name: Shell Smash
SHELL_SMASH.effect: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

SHIFT_GEAR.name: Shift Gear
SHIFT_GEAR.effect: The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.

SHOCK_WAVE.name: Shock Wave
SHOCK_WAVE.effect: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

SHORE_UP.name: Shore Up
SHORE_UP.effect: The user restores ½ of its max HP by kicking up a cloud of sand from its surroundings. In a sandstorm, the user restores ⅔ of its max HP instead.

SILK_TRAP.name: Silk Trap
SILK_TRAP.effect: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

SIZZLY_SLIDE.name: Sizzly Slide
SIZZLY_SLIDE.effect: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This also burns the target.

SKITTER_SMACK.name: Skitter Smack
SKITTER_SMACK.effect: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

SKY_DROP.name: Sky Drop
SKY_DROP.effect: The user takes the target into the sky on the first turn, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

SKY_UPPERCUT.name: Sky Uppercut
SKY_UPPERCUT.effect: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force. This move can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop.

SLACK_OFF.name: Slack Off
SLACK_OFF.effect: The user slacks off, restoring ½ of its max HP.

SMART_STRIKE.name: Smart Strike
SMART_STRIKE.effect: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

SNIPE_SHOT.name: Snipe Shot
SNIPE_SHOT.effect: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s moves and Abilities that draw in moves. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

SNOWSCAPE.name: Snowscape
SNOWSCAPE.effect: The user summons a snowstorm lasting 5 turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

SOFT_BOILED.name: Soft-Boiled
SOFT_BOILED.effect: The user produces itself a large egg, restoring ½ of its max HP.

SOLAR_BLADE.name: Solar Blade
SOLAR_BLADE.effect: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light’s energy and attacks on the next turn. In harsh sunlight, the user can attack immediately. This move’s power is halved in any other weather condition.

SPARKLY_SWIRL.name: Sparkly Swirl
SPARKLY_SWIRL.effect: The user attacks the target by wrapping it with a whirlwind of an overpowering scent. This also cures the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

SPECTRAL_THIEF.name: Spectral Thief
SPECTRAL_THIEF.effect: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.

SPICY_EXTRACT.name: Spicy Extract
SPICY_EXTRACT.effect: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target’s Attack stat and harshly lowering the target’s Defense stat.

SPIKE_CANNON.name: Spike Cannon
SPIKE_CANNON.effect: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit 2-5 times in a row.

SPIKY_SHIELD.name: Spiky Shield
SPIKY_SHIELD.effect: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn take damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

SPIN_OUT.name: Spin Out
SPIN_OUT.effect: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user’s Speed stat.

SPIRIT_BREAK.name: Spirit Break
SPIRIT_BREAK.effect: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target’s spirit. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

SPLISHY_SPLASH.name: Splishy Splash
SPLISHY_SPLASH.effect: The user charges a huge wave with electricity and hits the opposing Pokémon with the wave. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing targets.

SPORE.name: Spore
SPORE.effect: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

SPRINGTIDE_STORM.name: Springtide Storm
SPRINGTIDE_STORM.effect: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the Attack stats of opposing Pokémon.

STEAMROLLER.name: Steamroller
STEAMROLLER.effect: The user crushes its target by rolling over the target with its rolled-up body. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

STEAM_ERUPTION.name: Steam Eruption
STEAM_ERUPTION.effect: The user attacks by immersing targets in superheated steam. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target and will thaw out the user or target if one is frozen.

STEEL_BEAM.name: Steel Beam
STEEL_BEAM.effect: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. After attacking, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP.

STOMPING_TANTRUM.name: Stomping Tantrum
STOMPING_TANTRUM.effect: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user couldn’t act, or its move missed or failed on the previous turn.

STONE_AXE.name: Stone Axe
STONE_AXE.effect: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target, damaging opposing Pokémon that switch into battle equal to ⅛ of their max HP. The stone splinters’ damage will differ depending on the Pokémon’s type matchup with the Rock type.

STORED_POWER.name: Stored Power
STORED_POWER.effect: The user attacks the target with stored power. This move’s power is increased by 20 for each stage that the user’s stats have been boosted.

STORM_THROW.name: Storm Throw
STORM_THROW.effect: The user attacks by striking the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

STRENGTH_SAP.name: Strength Sap
STRENGTH_SAP.effect: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target’s Attack stat. It then lowers the target’s Attack stat.

STUFF_CHEEKS.name: Stuff Cheeks
STUFF_CHEEKS.effect: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

SUNNY_DAY.name: Sunny Day
SUNNY_DAY.effect: The user intensifies the sun for 5 turns, powering up Fire-type moves by 50%. The sunlight also halves the damage dealt by Water-type moves.

SUPERCELL_SLAM.name: Supercell Slam
SUPERCELL_SLAM.effect: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. The user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP if this move misses or fails. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

SUPER_FANG.name: Super Fang
SUPER_FANG.effect: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This deals damage to the target equal to ½ of their remaining HP.

SWAGGER.name: Swagger
SWAGGER.effect: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target’s Attack stat.

SWEET_KISS.name: Sweet Kiss
SWEET_KISS.effect: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

SWEET_SCENT.name: Sweet Scent
SWEET_SCENT.effect: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon’s evasiveness.

SYNTHESIS.name: Synthesis
SYNTHESIS.effect: The user produces energy through photosynthesis, restoring ½ of its max HP. In harsh sunlight, ⅔ of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions, ¼ of its max HP will be restored instead.

TACHYON_CUTTER.name: Tachyon Cutter
TACHYON_CUTTER.effect: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

TAKE_HEART.name: Take Heart
TAKE_HEART.effect: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

TEARFUL_LOOK.name: Tearful Look
TEARFUL_LOOK.effect: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

TEETER_DANCE.name: Teeter Dance
TEETER_DANCE.effect: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.

TEMPER_FLARE.name: Temper Flare
TEMPER_FLARE.effect: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user’s previous move failed.

TERA_BLAST.name: Tera Blast
TERA_BLAST.effect: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

TERA_STARSTORM.name: Tera Starstorm
TERA_STARSTORM.effect: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user when Terastallized.

TERRAIN_PULSE.name: Terrain Pulse
TERRAIN_PULSE.effect: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

THIEF.name: Thief
THIEF.effect: The user attacks and tries to steal from the target simultaneously. This move has a 30% chance to steal one of the target’s held items.

THOUSAND_ARROWS.name: Thousand Arrows
THOUSAND_ARROWS.effect: The user attacks by generating countless arrows from its internal energy and raining them down upon targets. This move can hit opposing Pokémon that are in the air, including those using Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop, knocking them down to the ground.

THROAT_CHOP.name: Throat Chop
THROAT_CHOP.effect: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for 2 turns.

THUNDERCLAP.name: Thunderclap
THUNDERCLAP.effect: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

TICKLE.name: Tickle
TICKLE.effect: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.

TIDY_UP.name: Tidy Up
TIDY_UP.effect: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

TRIPLE_DIVE.name: Triple Dive
TRIPLE_DIVE.effect: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water 3 times in a row.

TRUMP_CARD.name: Trump Card
TRUMP_CARD.effect: This move’s power starts at 40 and increases as its remaining PP decreases: 50 at 4 PP, 60 at 3 PP, 80 at 2 PP, and 200 at 1 PP. This move never misses.

TWIN_BEAM.name: Twin Beam
TWIN_BEAM.effect: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

UPROAR.name: Uproar
UPROAR.effect: The user attacks in an uproar for 3 turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

U_TURN.name: U-turn
U_TURN.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

VACUUM_WAVE.name: Vacuum Wave
VACUUM_WAVE.effect: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

VENOM_DRENCH.name: Venom Drench
VENOM_DRENCH.effect: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

VENOSHOCK.name: Venoshock
VENOSHOCK.effect: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.

VITAL_THROW.name: Vital Throw
VITAL_THROW.effect: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.

WATER_PLEDGE.name: Water Pledge
WATER_PLEDGE.effect: A column of water hits the target. When used alongside Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge, the moves will combine for 150 base power and summon a rainbow or vast swamp, respectively, for 4 turns.

WATER_SPOUT.name: Water Spout
WATER_SPOUT.effect: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The less HP the user has left, the lower this move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).

WAVE_CRASH.name: Wave Crash
WAVE_CRASH.effect: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move.

WHIRLPOOL.name: Whirlpool
WHIRLPOOL.effect: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn. This move’s power is doubled against targets submerged with Dive.

WILL_O_WISP.name: Will-O-Wisp
WILL_O_WISP.effect: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

WOOD_HAMMER.name: Wood Hammer
WOOD_HAMMER.effect: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move.

WORK_UP.name: Work Up
WORK_UP.effect: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.

WRING_OUT.name: Wring Out
WRING_OUT.effect: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 120).

ZING_ZAP.name: Zing Zap
ZING_ZAP.effect: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

ZIPPY_ZAP.name: Zippy Zap
ZIPPY_ZAP.effect: The user attacks the target with bursts of electricity at high speed. This move always goes first and results in a critical hit.

OVERGROW.name: Зарастание
OVERGROW.description: Повышает урон приёмов Травяного типа на 50%, если у Покемона осталось ⅓ ОЖ или меньше.

CHLOROPHYLL.name: Хлорофилл
CHLOROPHYLL.description: Удваитвает Скорость Покемона во время палящего Солнца.

BLAZE.name: Полыхание
BLAZE.description: Повышает урон приёмов Огненного типа на 50%, если у Покемона осталось ⅓ ОЖ или меньше.

SOLAR_POWER.name: Сила Солнца
SOLAR_POWER.description: Спец. Атака Покемона повышается на 50% во время палящего Солнца, но Покемон теряет ⅛ максимального ОЖ в конце каждого хода.

TOUGH_CLAWS.name: Tough Claws
TOUGH_CLAWS.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s contact moves by 30%.

DROUGHT.name: Засуха
DROUGHT.description: Когда этот Покемон входит в битву, выходит палящее Солнце.

TORRENT.name: Всплеск
TORRENT.description: Повышает урон приёмов Водяного типа на 50%, если у Покемона осталось ⅓ ОЖ или меньше.

RAIN_DISH.name: Блюдо Дождя
RAIN_DISH.description: Покемон постепенно востанавливает ¹⁄₁₆ своего максимального ОЖ в конце каждого хода во время дождя.

MEGA_LAUNCHER.name: Mega Launcher
MEGA_LAUNCHER.description: Boosts the power of Aura Sphere and moves with "Pulse" in their names by 50%.

RUN_AWAY.name: Бегство
RUN_AWAY.description: Гарантирует успешный побег от диких Покемонов.

SHED_SKIN.name: Сброс Кожи
SHED_SKIN.description: У Покемона 33% шанс сбросить кожу, и вылечить собственное статусное состояние в конце каждого хода.

TINTED_LENS.name: Усиленные Линзы
TINTED_LENS.description: "не очень эффективные" приёмы Покемона наносят двойной урон.

SWARM.name: Рой
SWARM.description: Повышает урон приёмов Насекомого типа на 50%, если у Покемона осталось ⅓ ОЖ или меньше.

SNIPER.name: Снайпер
SNIPER.description: Когда Покемон попадает критическим ударом, урон опять повышается на 50%, и наносит 225% нормального урона.

ADAPTABILITY.name: Приспособляемость
ADAPTABILITY.description: Увеличивает бонус к атакам одного и того же типа с 1.5 до 2-х. Не суммируется со Звёздной террасталлизацией.

TANGLED_FEET.name: Косолапость
TANGLED_FEET.description: Точность приёмов использованных против этого Покемона поделена пополам, если Покемон в замешательстве.

BIG_PECKS.name: Птичий Дух
BIG_PECKS.description: Защиту Покемона невозможно понизить с помощью приёмов или Способностей других Покемонов.

NO_GUARD.name: Без Охраны
NO_GUARD.description: Покемон борется без охраны, что гарантирует, что все атаки Покемона и соперника попадут по цели. Если этот Покемон первый при входе в битву, он(а) повышает шанс двойного сражения.

LIGHTNING_ROD.name: Громоотвод
LIGHTNING_ROD.description: Покемон притягивает все атаки Электрического типа. Вместо того, чтобы получить урон, у Покемона повышается Спец. Атака.

FLASH_FIRE.name: Вспышка Огня
FLASH_FIRE.description: Если этот Покемон атакован приёмом Огненного типа, он(а) поглощает огонь, и усиливает собственные приёмы Огненного типа на 50%.

EFFECT_SPORE.name: Споры
EFFECT_SPORE.description: При контакте с этим Покемоном, есть 30% шанс отравления, сна или паралича атакующего.

PICKUP.name: Подбиратель
PICKUP.description: Покемон имеет шанс подобрать предмет использованный другим Покемоном во время битвы, даже если он(а) не учавствовал(а).

TECHNICIAN.name: Техничность
TECHNICIAN.description: Усиливает атаки с базовой силой 60 или меньше, увеличивая урон на 50%.

UNNERVE.name: Напряжение
UNNERVE.description: Напрягает соперников до состояния, что они не могут есть Ягоды.

LIMBER.name: Гибкость
LIMBER.description: Гибкое тело Покемона не может быть парализованым.

INTIMIDATE.name: Устрашение
INTIMIDATE.description: Когда этот Покемон входит в битву, он(а) запугивает врагов, понижая их Aтаку.

JUSTIFIED.name: Justified
JUSTIFIED.description: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type move, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

SYNCHRONIZE.name: Синхронность
SYNCHRONIZE.description: Передаёт свой статусное состояние Покемону, который(ая) его нанёс(ла). Если этот Покемона первый при входе в битву, у диких Покемонов будет такой же характер.

MAGIC_GUARD.name: Магическая Стража
MAGIC_GUARD.description: Покемон получает урон только от прямых атак.

TRACE.name: След
TRACE.description: Когда Покемон входит в битву, он(а) копирует способность противника.

GUTS.name: Сила Воли
GUTS.description: У Покемона настолько сильная сила воли, что статусные состояния повышают Атаку Покемона на 50%.

STEADFAST.name: Неукротимый
STEADFAST.description: Решимость Покемона повышает его(её) скорость, каждый раз когда он вздрагивает.

STURDY.name: Стойкость
STURDY.description: Этого Покемона нельзя повергнуть одним ударом, если у него максимальное ОЖ, включая атаки, которые повергают моментально.

MAGNET_PULL.name: Магнетизм
MAGNET_PULL.description: Не позволяет Покемонам Стального типа покидать битву, притягивая их своим магнетизмом.

ANALYTIC.name: Анализ
ANALYTIC.description: Повышает урон приёмов использованных этим Покемоном на 30%, если этот Покемон использует приём последним во время хода.

LEVITATE.name: Левитация
LEVITATE.description: Покемон парит в воздухе, и получает полный иммунитет от всех приёмов Землянного типа.

CURSED_BODY.name: Порочное Тело
CURSED_BODY.description: При получении урона от какого-то приёма, у этого Покемона есть 30% шанс отключить эту атаку сопернику.

SHADOW_TAG.name: Метка Тени
SHADOW_TAG.description: Покемона наступает на тень противника, и запрещает им покинуть битву или переключиться.

WEAK_ARMOR.name: Слабая Броня
WEAK_ARMOR.description: Если покемон получает урон от физического приёма, его Защита понижается, но Скорость резко повышается.

RECKLESS.name: Безрассудный
RECKLESS.description: Повышает урон приёмов с отдачей на 20%.

NATURAL_CURE.name: Самолечение
NATURAL_CURE.description: Статусные состояние этого Покемона излечены, когда он(а) переключается.

SERENE_GRACE.name: Тихая Грация
SERENE_GRACE.description: Удваивает вероятность дополнительных эффектов, происходящих, когда этот Покемон использует приёмы. Этот не влияет на предметы.

SWIFT_SWIM.name: Пловец Дождя
SWIFT_SWIM.description: Удваитвает Скорость Покемона во время дождя.

POISON_POINT.name: Точки Яда
POISON_POINT.description: У Покемона 30% шанс отравить Покемонов, которые касаются его(её) при атаке.

RATTLED.name: Rattled
RATTLED.description: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

MOXIE.name: Moxie
MOXIE.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

MOLD_BREAKER.name: Неформальный
MOLD_BREAKER.description: Способности противника не могут остановить приёмы этого Покемона.

WATER_ABSORB.name: Аквапитание
WATER_ABSORB.description: Если этот Покемон атакован приёмом Водного типа, он(а) востанавливает ¼ своего максимального ОЖ, вместо того, чтобы получить урон.

SHELL_ARMOR.name: Панцирь-Щит
SHELL_ARMOR.description: Крепкая панцирь этого Покемона защищает от критических ударов.

HYDRATION.name: Гидрирование
HYDRATION.description: Исцеляет статусные состояния Покемона в конце каждого хода во время дождя.

ANTICIPATION.name: Предвидение
ANTICIPATION.description: Покемона может предвидеть опасные приёмы у соперника.

VOLT_ABSORB.name: Вольтпитание
VOLT_ABSORB.description: Если этот Покемон атакован приёмом Электрического типа, он(а) востанавливает ¼ своего максимального ОЖ, вместо того, чтобы получить урон.

QUICK_FEET.name: Быстрый Шаг
QUICK_FEET.description: Повышает Скорость Покемона на 50% если у Покемона есть статусное состояние.

IMMUNITY.name: Иммунитет
IMMUNITY.description: Имунная система Покемона защищает его(её) от отравления.

GLUTTONY.name: Обжорство
GLUTTONY.description: Если Покемон держит Ягоду, которая поедатся когда ОЖ равно ¼ максимального значения или меньше, например Старф-Ягода, эта Ягода будет съедена, когда ОЖ равно половине максимального значения или меньше.

FLAME_BODY.name: Огненное тело
FLAME_BODY.description: У Покемона 30% шанс поджечь Покемонов, которые касаются его(её) при атаке.

MARVEL_SCALE.name: Дивная Чешуя
MARVEL_SCALE.description: Дивная чешуя Покемона повышает его(её) Защиту на 50%, если он(а) под эффектами статусного состояния.

MULTISCALE.name: Мульти-Чешуя
MULTISCALE.description: Уменьшает урон полученный Покемоном в два раза, если у Покемона максимальное ОЖ.

LEAF_GUARD.name: Листостраж
LEAF_GUARD.description: Защищает от статусных состояний во время палящего Солнца.

MEGA_SOL.name: Mega Sol
MEGA_SOL.description: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

SHEER_FORCE.name: Грубая Сила
SHEER_FORCE.description: Убирает все дополнительные эффекты у приёмов этого Покемона, но повышает их урон на 30%.

DRAGONIZE.name: Dragonize
DRAGONIZE.description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

HUSTLE.name: Энергичность
HUSTLE.description: Повышает Атаку Покемона на 50%, но понижает Точность физических приёмов на 20%.

SUPER_LUCK.name: Супер Удача
SUPER_LUCK.description: Этому Покемону везёт настолько сильно, что шанс критических ударов повышен на одну стадию.

PLUS.name: Плюс
PLUS.description: Повышает Спец. Атаку Покемона на 50%, если в битве присутствует союзник со способностью Плюс или Минус.

EARLY_BIRD.name: Жаворонок
EARLY_BIRD.description: Покемон просыпается ото сна в два раза быстрее других Покемонов.

MAGIC_BOUNCE.name: Magic Bounce
MAGIC_BOUNCE.description: Instead of being affected by other Pokémon’s status moves, the Pokémon bounces them back at the user.

PRANKSTER.name: Prankster
PRANKSTER.description: Increases the priority of the Pokémon’s status moves by 1 stage. Dark-type Pokémon are immune to these moves.

SAND_FORCE.name: Sand Force
SAND_FORCE.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves by 30% in a sandstorm. The Pokémon also takes no damage from sandstorms.

LIGHT_METAL.name: Лёгкий Метал
LIGHT_METAL.description: Уменьшает вес Покемона в два раза.

CONTRARY.name: Перевёртыш
CONTRARY.description: Переворачивает все изменения характеристик этого Покемона таким образом, что попытки понизить его(её) характеристику наоборот повысит её - а попытка повысить характеристику понизит.

SKILL_LINK.name: Навык Связи
SKILL_LINK.description: Этот покемон всегда наносит максимум ударов атаками, бьющими по нескольку раз за ход.

PICKPOCKET.name: Карманник
PICKPOCKET.description: Покемон крадёт предметы у соперников, которые касаются его(её) при атаке.

STALWART.name: Stalwart
STALWART.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

REGENERATOR.name: Регенерация
REGENERATOR.description: Покемон востанавливает ⅓ своего максимального ОЖ когда он(а) переключается.

UNBURDEN.name: Освобождение
UNBURDEN.description: Удваивает Скорость Покемона, если предмет, который он(а) держал(а), был использован или потерян.

TELEPATHY.name: Телепатия
TELEPATHY.description: Этот Покемон выжидает и уклоняется от атак своего напарника в битве.

PIXILATE.name: Pixilate
PIXILATE.description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

INFILTRATOR.name: Infiltrator
INFILTRATOR.description: When using its moves, the Pokémon ignores the effects of targets’ Light Screen, Reflect, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, and substitutes.

WONDER_GUARD.name: Чудо-Защита
WONDER_GUARD.description: Благодаря своей загадочной силе, Покемон получает урон только от суперэффективнх приёмов.

HYPER_CUTTER.name: Гипер резак
HYPER_CUTTER.description: Могучие клещи этого Покемона не позволяют другим Покемонам понижать его(её) Атаку.

FILTER.name: Фильтр
FILTER.description: Понижает урон суперэффективных приёмов использованных против Покемона на 25%.

MINUS.name: Минус
MINUS.description: Повышает Спец. Атаку Покемона на 50%, если в битве присутствует союзник со способностью Плюс или Минус.

WHITE_SMOKE.name: Белый Дым
WHITE_SMOKE.description: Белый дым защищает Покемона, что не позволяет соперникам понижать его(её) характеристики.

SUCTION_CUPS.name: Присоски
SUCTION_CUPS.description: Покемон использует присоски, чтобы не двигаться с места. Это защищает его(её) от приёмов, которые заставили бы его(её) переключиться.

STORM_DRAIN.name: Водоотвод
STORM_DRAIN.description: Покемон притягивает все атаки Водного типа. Вместо того, чтобы получить урон, у Покемона повышается Спец. Атака.

BATTLE_ARMOR.name: Боевая Броня
BATTLE_ARMOR.description: Крепкая броня этого Покемона защищает от критических ударов.

CUTE_CHARM.name: Очарование
CUTE_CHARM.description: Есть 30% шанс, что Покемон влюбит в себя Покемонов, которые касаются его(её) при атаке.

MOODY.name: Холерик
MOODY.description: В конце каждого хода случайная характеристика Покемона резко повышается, но другая случайная характеристика понижается. Не влияет на Точность и Уворотливость.

REFRIGERATE.name: Refrigerate
REFRIGERATE.description: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

CLEAR_BODY.name: Чистое Тело
CLEAR_BODY.description: Не позволяет атакам или способностям других Покемонов понижать характеристики этого Покемона.

PRIMORDIAL_SEA.name: Primordial Sea
PRIMORDIAL_SEA.description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.

IRON_FIST.name: Кулак-Сталь
IRON_FIST.description: Усиливает силу приёмов использующих кулаки на 20%.

RIVALRY.name: Конкуренция
RIVALRY.description: Дух соперничества этого Покемона, повышает его(её) урон против Покемонов одинакового пола на 25%, но также понижает урон против Покемонов противоположного пола на 25%.

STICKY_HOLD.name: Цепкий Захват
STICKY_HOLD.description: Предметы, которые держит этот Покемон цеплаются к его(её) липкому телу и не могут быть потеряны.

SCRAPPY.name: Дерзость
SCRAPPY.description: Покемона может атаковать противников Призрачного типа используя приёмы Боевого и Нормального типа. На Покемона также не влияет способность Устрашение.

SNOW_WARNING.name: Снежная Буря
SNOW_WARNING.description: Когда этот Покемон входит в битву, начинается снежная буря.

SOUNDPROOF.name: Звукозащита
SOUNDPROOF.description: Звукозащита даёт Покемона полный иммунитет от всех приёмов основывающихся на звуке.

SOLID_ROCK.name: Каменистый
SOLID_ROCK.description: Понижает урон суперэффективных приёмов использованных против Покемона на 25%.

SHARPNESS.name: Sharpness
SHARPNESS.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s slicing moves by 50%.

MULTITYPE.name: Мульти-тип
MULTITYPE.description: Меняет тип Покемона в зависимости от Плиты, которую он(а) держит.

SAND_RUSH.name: Песчаный Жар
SAND_RUSH.description: Удваивает Скорость Покемона во время песчаной бури. Покемон также не получает урон от песчаной бури.

PIERCING_DRILL.name: Piercing Drill
PIERCING_DRILL.description: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing ¼ of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.

POISON_TOUCH.name: Ядовитое Касание
POISON_TOUCH.description: Когда Покемон использует приём, который касается противника, у него(неё) есть 30% шанс отравить противника.

OVERCOAT.name: Дождевик
OVERCOAT.description: Покемон не получает урон от песчаной бури или града, а также получает иммунитет от приёмов и Способностей использующих порошки или споры.

ANGER_POINT.name: Точка Гнева
ANGER_POINT.description: Покемон входит в гнев, когда по нему попадают критическим ударом, что повышает его Атаку.

SLUSH_RUSH.name: Slush Rush
SLUSH_RUSH.description: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat in snow or hail. The Pokémon also takes no damage from hail.

DEFIANT.name: Непокорность
DEFIANT.description: Если у этого Покемона понижена любая характеристика, у него(неё) резко повысится Атака.

SAP_SIPPER.name: Sap Sipper
SAP_SIPPER.description: Grass-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Attack stat.

TURBOBLAZE.name: Turboblaze
TURBOBLAZE.description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

TERAVOLT.name: Teravolt
TERAVOLT.description: The Pokémon’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

MAGICIAN.name: Magician
MAGICIAN.description: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

PROTEAN.name: Protean
PROTEAN.description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

FIRE_MANE.name: Fire Mane
FIRE_MANE.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves by 50%.

STANCE_CHANGE.name: Stance Change
STANCE_CHANGE.description: The Pokémon changes into its Blade Forme when it attacks and changes into its Shield Forme when it uses the move King’s Shield.

DRY_SKIN.name: Сухая Кожа
DRY_SKIN.description: Покемон востанавливает ¼ максимального ОЖ, когда его(её) атакуют приёмом Водного типа, и ⅛ максимального ОЖ в конце каждого хода во время дождя. Однако, Покемон получает на 25% больше урона от приёмов Огенного типа, и теряет ⅛ максимального ОЖ во время палящего Солнца.

STRONG_JAW.name: Strong Jaw
STRONG_JAW.description: The Pokémon’s strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves by 50%.

FRISK.name: Обыск
FRISK.description: Когда Покемон входит в битву, он(а) узнаёт какая способность у противника.

LONG_REACH.name: Long Reach
LONG_REACH.description: None of the moves used by the Pokémon are considered contact moves.

LIQUID_VOICE.name: Liquid Voice
LIQUID_VOICE.description: The Pokémon’s sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

VITAL_SPIRIT.name: Живой Дух
VITAL_SPIRIT.description: Живой дух этого Покемона не позволяет ему(ей) уснуть.

MERCILESS.name: Merciless
MERCILESS.description: The Pokémon’s attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

STAMINA.name: Stamina
STAMINA.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, its Defense stat is boosted.

WATER_BUBBLE.name: Water Bubble
WATER_BUBBLE.description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from Fire-type moves and doubles the power of its Water-type moves. The Pokémon cannot be burned.

STEELWORKER.name: Steelworker
STEELWORKER.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s Steel-type moves by 50%.

PSYCHIC_SURGE.name: Psychic Surge
PSYCHIC_SURGE.description: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

MISTY_SURGE.name: Misty Surge
MISTY_SURGE.description: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

SHADOW_SHIELD.name: Shadow Shield
SHADOW_SHIELD.description: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full. This effect cannot be ignored by other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities.

LIBERO.name: Libero
LIBERO.description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

MIRROR_ARMOR.name: Mirror Armor
MIRROR_ARMOR.description: Instead of being affected by stat-lowering effects, the Pokémon bounces them back at whichever Pokémon caused them.

PUNK_ROCK.name: Punk Rock
PUNK_ROCK.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon’s sound-based moves by 30%. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves

SCREEN_CLEANER.name: Screen Cleaner
SCREEN_CLEANER.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

INTREPID_SWORD.name: Intrepid Sword
INTREPID_SWORD.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

UNAWARE.name: Безразличие
UNAWARE.description: Покемон игнорирует изменения в характеристике соперника когда он(а) атакует или защищается.

PURIFYING_SALT.name: Purifying Salt
PURIFYING_SALT.description: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

SPICY_SPRAY.name: Spicy Spray
SPICY_SPRAY.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

OPPORTUNIST.name: Opportunist
OPPORTUNIST.description: When an opponent’s stats are boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost its own stats in the exact same way.

TOXIC_DEBRIS.name: Toxic Debris
TOXIC_DEBRIS.description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

WATER_VEIL.name: Водная Завеса
WATER_VEIL.description: Водная завеса этого Покемона защищает его(её) от поджога.

SUPREME_OVERLORD.name: Supreme Overlord
SUPREME_OVERLORD.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the power of its moves is boosted by 10% for each Pokémon in its party that has been defeated in battle already. The maximum boost is 50%

PROTOSYNTHESIS.name: Protosynthesis
PROTOSYNTHESIS.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.

QUARK_DRIVE.name: Quark Drive
QUARK_DRIVE.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.

THERMAL_EXCHANGE.name: Thermal Exchange
THERMAL_EXCHANGE.description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

GOOD_AS_GOLD.name: Good as Gold
GOOD_AS_GOLD.description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.

ORICHALCUM_PULSE.name: Orichalcum Pulse
ORICHALCUM_PULSE.description: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat by 33% in harsh sunlight.

HADRON_ENGINE.name: Hadron Engine
HADRON_ENGINE.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat by 33% on Electric Terrain.

PARALYSIS.obtain:
